title: EmbeddingRequest
description: The one embedding call shape for the whole estate: an OpenAI-compatible request (input: str | str[]) that PINS the sovereign model and dimension by const. This contract is the seam the finding demands — Noetica's doc-store and the platform apps/embeddings service must both speak exactly this, so every chunk lands in one comparable vector space instead of Noetica's ollama space and the platform service's space drifting apart. The model/dimension are const, not free strings: a request for any other model or a Matryoshka-truncated dimension fails validation, by construction.

id.description: Stable URN identifier. Pattern: urn:srcos:embedding-request:<local-id>. Identity is stable and never reused.

specVersion.description: Contract version, pinned per the tranche-0001 discipline. Changing this const is a contract change.

model.description: The sovereign embedding model id served by prophet-platform apps/embeddings. Pinned by const — the shared-vector-space anchor.

dimension.description: The embedding dimension of the pinned model. Pinned by const so no producer may silently truncate (Matryoshka) into an incomparable space.
